title: Chapter 001
synopsis: WiraMadha faces a tough decision regarding quests in the game Nusantara Reborn Online, particularly against the powerful Naga Getih.

scenes.title: Wira's Decision
scenes.summary: Wira weighs options for quests while worried about the strength of the Naga Getih boss.
scenes.text: Wira considers the daunting challenge of defeating Naga Getih and decides to take a quest up Mount Bromo.

events.summary: Wira selects the quest to Mount Bromo and acquires a swift mount named Osmo.
